newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mixed.

text.p: Soymeal basis offers were mixed on Wednesday with weakness noted where harvest was underway but some strength seen in other areas, several U.S. Midwest cash soymeal brokers said.
"With the corn starting to show up and the price of corn being low relative to meal, I think (end-users) are starting to feed corn a little bit heavier," a Kentucky broker said.

But strength was reported in Danville and Decatur, Ill., where processors were scrambling for tight supplies with harvest at least one week away, dealers said. Old crop beans were hard to find, they said.
End-users continued to buy mostly hand to mouth in anticipation of harvest bringing lower prices, several dealers said.
